title: PlatformOwnerSecretPut
description: platform.owner-secret-put@1 (AI Exchange D11): body of PUT /internal/owner-settings/secrets/:key on the service that owns the secret. The value is sent once, sealed by the service, and never returned, logged or echoed. `bind` is the https origin the value is sealed to (a provider key is bound to its provider's origin); changing the destination makes the value unusable until the owner enters it again. The answer is the setting without the value. Each request carries the owner as actor and the service audits the write with that actor and key, never the value.

value.description: The secret, once. Never stored outside the owning service and never returned.

bind.description: The https origin the value is sealed to; optional.

type.description: The owner; a service or an app is never the actor.
